The following events took place in '''4001 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Andur Sunrider]] arrives on the planet [[H'ratth]] and begins his [[Jedi training/Legends|Jedi training]] under Master [[Chamma]].<ref name="TotJC">[[Andur Sunrider]] left [[H'ratth]] for [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]] in [[3999 BBY]] per [[Tales of the Jedi 3|''Tales of the Jedi'' 3]]. Page 18 of the ''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]'' says that 2 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior (4001 BBY), Andur went to H'ratth.</ref>
